title: Unified Full H1 Suffix
objective: Compile a native retrying H1 suffix with live logical dimensions, source-policy precision transitions, exact replay, transactional publication, and caller-capped incomplete state

handoff.summary: Added a source-transparent native retrying H1 suffix. It consumes live logical dimensions and a caller cap, retries through pari_live_retry_transition, preserves phase bits and the embedding/getfu layout boundary, exactly validates getfu units, and publishes all public owners transactionally only after genuine success. The authentic fixture reaches signed-getfu success at the policy-selected p2304; p192 and p2048 caps remain incomplete without publication.
risks: The focused checker injects the separately qualified bridge compact provenance and factor transform, so this receipt covers the native suffix rather than the complete candidate-to-authority graph.
pnpm architecture:check remains blocked by the pre-existing unclassified bench/pari-class-group-port/pari_h1_outcome_c_adapter.c outside this lane's claims.
next_steps: Integration should compose pari_live_retrying_h1_suffix after the same-addon live owner bridge, passing the resident-derived logical dimensions and bridge-owned transforms directly.
